From the photographic archive

Fruit & More

86-90 Clapham High Street, London SW4 7UL

Delicatessen and café

A moment on the high street

What the photograph records

The former Fruit & More delicatessen and café at 86-90 Clapham High Street, London SW4 7UL, photographed on 3 April 2026 after closure. Its dark shop sign remains above a graffiti-covered shutter, with scaffolding covering the building above.

Photographed
3 April 2026
Recorded state
Vacant when photographed
Business type
Delicatessen and café

This record describes the premises on the photograph date. Later changes may not yet be included in the archive.

A few dates in the story

  1. 3 April 2026 Documented

    Fruit & More: closed by this date

    The project photographer confirms Fruit & More had ceased trading at this address by the time this photograph was taken. The exact closing date is unknown.
